title: Absence of Superconductivity in the Pure Two-Dimensional Hubbard Model
authors_short: Qin, Chung, Shi, Vitali, Hubig, Schollwöck, White, Zhang
one_line: AFQMC+DMRG交叉验证：纯Hubbard模型(t'=0,U=8)近最优掺杂无超导，基态是填充条纹相
why: 本方向的方法学门槛标杆（handshake验证）

title: Coexistence of superconductivity with partially filled stripes in the Hubbard model
authors_short: Xu, Chung, Qin, Schollwöck, White, Zhang
one_line: 加入t'（尤其t'<0）后，超导可与部分填充条纹共存，电子/空穴掺杂不对称
why: 解决条纹-超导互斥旧图像

title: Origin and fate of the pseudogap in the doped Hubbard model
one_line: 有限温对角化图解蒙特卡洛(无限尺寸、任意动量分辨率)证明T→0极限精确对应基态条纹相
why: 首次严格连接有限温pseudogap物理与T=0序参量

title: Superconductivity in the two-dimensional Hubbard model revealed by neural quantum states
one_line: Pfaffian神经网络量子态独立复现handshake结论：|t'|>0.1条纹+SC共存；U=4更高掺杂即使t'=0也有均匀d波SC
why: 第三种独立方法(NQS)交叉确认

title: Solving the Hubbard model with Neural Quantum States
authors_short: Gu, Li, Lin, Zhan, Li, Huang, He, Wu, Xiang, Qin, Wang, Lv
one_line: Transformer-based NQS确认t'-Hubbard模型半填充条纹基态
why: 标志NQS方法在2025年迅速成熟

title: Optimizing Superconductivity: From Cuprates via Nickelates to Palladates
authors_short: Kitatani, Si, Worm, Katukuri, Arrigoni, Held
one_line: DΓA扫描单带Hubbard模型Tc找到最优点；铜氧化物/镍酸盐都不在最优点，某些钯酸盐接近最优
why: 理论预测未合成材料的具体可检验案例

title: Microscopic mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity revealed by ab initio studies on hole-doped multilayer cuprates HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8 under pressure
one_line: mVMC+cRPA下折延伸到Hg1223高压，用普适标度Tc,opt≈0.16|t1|F_SC定性解释Tc压力圆顶
why: '从材料结构算到Tc趋势并对比实验'最系统的ab initio路线

title: Towards an ab initio theory of high-temperature superconductors: a study of multilayer cuprates
one_line: CDMFT+DFT电荷自洽应用于两个多层铜氧化物家族，解释层数依赖Tc峰值
why: cluster-DMFT路线里少见的材料特异性预测尝试

title: Global Phase Diagram of D-wave Superconductivity in the Square-Lattice t-J Model
one_line: 8-leg DMRG给出t-J模型全局相图，小t2抑制PDW/CDW使d波SC均匀化
why: 把t-Hubbard争议延伸到t-J模型的系统性大尺寸研究

title: Fragmented superconductivity in the Hubbard model as solitons in Ginzburg-Landau theory
one_line: DMRG研究t-t'-U Hubbard模型强耦合区，CDW存在时Cooper对凝聚碎片化
why: 揭示条纹-超导共存的一种具体机制

title: In search of exotic pairing in the Hubbard model: many-body computation and quantum gas microscopy
authors_short: Feng, Hartke, He, Oreg, Turnbaugh, Jia, Zwierlein, Zhang
one_line: 冷原子量子气体显微镜实验与CP-AFQMC计算交叉验证，预测FFLO配对前兆信号
why: 理论计算+量子模拟实验直接交叉验证的具体案例

title: Downfolding from Ab Initio to Interacting Model Hamiltonians: Comprehensive Analysis and Benchmarking of the DFT+cRPA Approach
authors_short: Chang, van Loon, Eskridge, Busemeyer, Morales, Dreyer, Millis, Zhang, Wehling, Wagner, Rösner
one_line: 系统比较DFT+cRPA下折各环节误差，target basis选择比双计数修正/屏蔽模型更决定模型质量
why: 自主做下折建模的方法论必读文献

title: Stripe order in the underdoped region of the two-dimensional Hubbard model
authors_short: Zheng, Chung, Corboz, Ehlers, Qin, Noack, Shi, White, Zhang, Chan
one_line: 早期Simons Collaboration基准论文，首次确立1/8掺杂附近条纹为强耦合基态候选（agent 注：arXiv ID 未逐字核实）
why: 本方向争议的历史起点

title: TRILEX and GW+EDMFT approach to d-wave superconductivity in the Hubbard model
one_line: TRILEX方法应用于d波超导的早期代表作，arXiv ID未核实
why: 图解扩展DMFT方法在本领域的代表性应用

title: Strongly correlated superconductivity with long-range spatial fluctuations
one_line: 综述GW+(E)DMFT/FLEX+DMFT/DΓA/dual fermion/TRILEX/DMF2RG等图解扩展DMFT方法在超导中的应用
why: 图解扩展方法的入门综述

title: Topological Melting of Magnetic Stripes and the Emergence of Macroscopic d-wave Superconductivity in the 2D Hubbard Model
one_line: 【存疑，勿作为定论引用】声称纯Hubbard模型不需t'即有稳健d波SC，与Qin2020/Xu2024/Roth2025三方法共识矛盾；单作者、无交叉验证
why: 收录是为了提醒勿误引，而非作为进展

title: Downfolding from ab initio to interacting model Hamiltonians (镍酸盐GW版)
one_line: 无限层镍酸盐的GW下折研究，与cRPA下折路线互补（未深入核实）
